description: DEFNEX MLOps Backend MVP - Phase 1-8 domain implementation (dataset, validation, training, model registry, evaluation, promotion, deployment, end-to-end integration). Phase 0 (foundation) is already implemented and committed.

userStories.title: Add Dataset & DatasetVersion models + migration
userStories.description: As a backend, I need persisted Dataset and DatasetVersion tables so dataset lineage can be tracked.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy models Dataset and DatasetVersion added under app/models/, matching docs/prd/mlops-backend-mvp.md §6/§7 (dataset_id, dataset_version as INTEGER, source info, canonical schema metadata, manifest metadata)
Models imported in app/models/__init__.py so Alembic autogenerate detects them
alembic revision --autogenerate generates a migration and alembic upgrade head applies it cleanly
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add dataset Pydantic schemas + service layer
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a service layer to register datasets and create/read dataset versions, matching the DatasetManifest/DatasetVersion schemas in docs/api/openapi.yaml.
acceptanceCriteria: Pydantic schemas in app/schemas/dataset.py matching openapi.yaml's DatasetManifest, DatasetVersionCreateRequest, DatasetVersion, DatasetSummary
Service functions in app/services/dataset_service.py: register_dataset, create_dataset_version, get_dataset_version, list_dataset_versions
dataset_version handled as INTEGER end-to-end (per PRD §7's resolved deviation, not the string type still in docs/dataset/validation-rules.md)
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add dataset API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need dataset endpoints available so I can register datasets and browse versions, per docs/api/openapi.yaml.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /datasets, POST /datasets/{dataset_id}/versions, GET /datasets/{dataset_id}/versions, GET /datasets/{dataset_id}/versions/{version} implemented per openapi.yaml paths/schemas
404 responses use the standard error envelope from PRD §18 (e.g. DATASET_NOT_FOUND)
API tests cover request validation, response schema, and the 404 error case
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add ValidationReport model + migration
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a persisted ValidationReport table linked to a dataset version.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy model ValidationReport added, matching docs/dataset/validation-rules.md's record shape (status VALID/INVALID/NEEDS_REVIEW, no separate warning status)
alembic revision --autogenerate + alembic upgrade head apply cleanly
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add validation service (schema/duplicate/leakage checks)
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a validation service that runs the rules defined in docs/dataset/validation-rules.md against a dataset version and produces a report.
acceptanceCriteria: Validation service in app/services/validation_service.py implements schema validation, required-field validation, role/message validation, malformed-data detection, duplicate detection, and train/eval leakage detection exactly as specified in docs/dataset/validation-rules.md
No new numeric thresholds invented beyond what validation-rules.md already defines
Service returns a validation report object matching the ValidationReport schema in openapi.yaml
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add validation API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to trigger validation on a dataset version and fetch its validation reports.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /datasets/{dataset_id}/versions/{version}/validate, GET .../validation-reports, GET .../validation-reports/latest implemented per openapi.yaml
API tests cover request validation, response schema, error response, and the VALID/INVALID/NEEDS_REVIEW status values
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add TrainingRun model + training config schema + migration
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a persisted TrainingRun table storing the training config snapshot actually used for that run.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy model TrainingRun added per PRD §9/§11 (training_run_id, dataset reference, training_config snapshot, status, timestamps, artifact reference, error info)

TrainingConfig Pydantic schema matches openapi.yaml, with the baseline defaults from PRD §11 (base_model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, PEFT DoRA, BF16, 4-bit=false, max_seq_length=4096) as configurable, non-hardcoded values
alembic revision --autogenerate + alembic upgrade head apply cleanly
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add training service, state machine, and lightweight worker
userStories.description: As a backend, I need training runs to execute asynchronously via a lightweight worker process, not block the HTTP request.
acceptanceCriteria: Training service creates a TrainingRun in QUEUED status without waiting for training to finish
State machine enforces QUEUED -> RUNNING -> COMPLETED or QUEUED -> RUNNING -> FAILED (per PRD §9)
Lightweight worker in app/workers/ picks up queued jobs, transitions status, and can run independently of the FastAPI process (per PRD §10)
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add mock training runner
userStories.description: As a developer without VM/GPU access, I need training runs to complete end-to-end using a mock runner that produces a fake artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: Mock runner takes a QUEUED TrainingRun through RUNNING to COMPLETED and writes a fake/test artifact reference, without requiring Unsloth or a GPU (per PRD §20)
Mock runner is swappable for the real Unsloth runner later without changing the API contract
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add training run API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to create training runs and poll their status.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /training-runs and GET /training-runs/{training_run_id} implemented per openapi.yaml
POST /training-runs returns immediately with QUEUED status, does not block on training completion
API tests cover request validation, response schema, error response, and lifecycle transitions
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add Model & ModelVersion models + migration
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a persisted model registry with lineage fields, matching docs/registry/model-artifact-versioning-lineage.md exactly.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy models Model and ModelVersion added with lineage fields per docs/registry/model-artifact-versioning-lineage.md: model_id, version, status, training_run_id (required), dataset_id, dataset_version, base_model (top-level, not nested in training_config), training_config, artifacts, created_at, promotion_decision_ref

Do NOT add an evaluation_id field - it is not defined in docs/registry/model-artifact-versioning-lineage.md or docs/api/openapi.yaml; evaluation is embedded directly on the model version record instead
alembic revision --autogenerate + alembic upgrade head apply cleanly
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add model registry service + artifact storage abstraction
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a service that registers a model artifact produced by a completed training run, plus a storage abstraction so the artifact location isn't hardcoded to local disk.
acceptanceCriteria: Service in app/services/model_service.py registers a ModelVersion from a COMPLETED TrainingRun with full lineage per docs/registry/model-artifact-versioning-lineage.md §7
Artifact storage abstraction (e.g. a small interface) wraps the local filesystem path used in Phase 0-era prototyping, so it can be swapped later without changing callers
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add model registry API endpoints
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to list models and fetch a specific model version's lineage.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /models and GET /models/{model_id}/versions/{version} implemented per openapi.yaml
Response includes full lineage fields (training_run_id, dataset_id, dataset_version, base_model, artifacts, status)
API tests cover response schema and the 404 error case
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add evaluation persistence, service, and API
userStories.description: As a backend, I need to store evaluation results (eval loss trend, 20-question benchmark, general-domain regression check) against a model version.
acceptanceCriteria: Evaluation fields persisted on the model version record per docs/registry/model-artifact-versioning-lineage.md §5 (not a separate evaluation_id foreign key)
GET and POST .../evaluation endpoints implemented per openapi.yaml, accepting the three evidence types from PRD §13 without inventing a numeric pass/fail threshold
API tests cover request validation and response schema
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add PromotionDecision model + migration
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a persisted PromotionDecision table capturing a frozen evidence snapshot at decision time.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy model PromotionDecision added per docs/registry/model-promotion-approval-workflow.md §8: decision_id, model_id, version, decision, decided_by, decided_at, evidence_snapshot (frozen copy, not a live reference), rationale, rollback_of_version
alembic revision --autogenerate + alembic upgrade head apply cleanly
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add promotion/rejection service, state transitions, and API
userStories.description: As a human reviewer, I need to promote or reject an EVALUATED model version, recording a rationale and evidence snapshot.
acceptanceCriteria: Service enforces the state machine REGISTERED -> EVALUATED -> PROMOTED|REJECTED -> DEPLOYED -> RETIRED per docs/registry/model-promotion-approval-workflow.md §2
POST .../decisions endpoint implemented per openapi.yaml; decision is human-controlled only, no automatic promotion based on numeric thresholds
State transition tests cover valid and invalid transitions
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add rollback endpoint
userStories.description: As a human reviewer, I need to roll back a deployed model to a previous version using the same decision-record mechanism.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /models/{model_id}/rollback implemented per openapi.yaml, reusing the PromotionDecision record with decision=ROLLBACK and evidence_snapshot=null per docs/registry/model-promotion-approval-workflow.md §9
API tests cover the rollback request/response and error cases
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add Deployment model + migration
userStories.description: As a backend, I need a persisted Deployment table kept conceptually separate from the model registry.
acceptanceCriteria: SQLAlchemy model Deployment added per PRD §15: deployment_id, model_id, model_version, environment, status, deployed_at
Deployment table has no foreign dependency that would merge it with the model registry's own status field
alembic revision --autogenerate + alembic upgrade head apply cleanly
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add deployment service, API, and mock serving abstraction
userStories.description: As a frontend, I need to deploy a promoted model version and check what's currently deployed, without the backend assuming a concrete serving stack.
acceptanceCriteria: POST .../deploy and GET /models/{model_id}/deployment implemented per openapi.yaml
Serving implementation stays mock/TBD - no vLLM/llama.cpp specifics assumed before the VM environment is confirmed (per PRD §15/§26)
API tests cover request validation, response schema, and error response
pytest passes

userStories.title: Add end-to-end integration test across the full lifecycle
userStories.description: As a project stakeholder, I need proof that the full closed-loop lifecycle works together, not just in isolated domain tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration test exercises Dataset -> Validation -> Training Run -> Model Registry -> Evaluation -> Promotion -> Deployment using the mock training runner, per PRD §19/§25
Test asserts IDs stay consistent and lineage is complete end-to-end (dataset_id/version -> training_run_id -> model_id/version -> evaluation -> promotion_decision_ref -> deployment_id)
docker compose up brings up the backend and the integration test suite runs against it (or an equivalent local run) without requiring a GPU
pytest passes
